d: Matt and Summer volunteer their time when cutbacks put the Baywatch lifeguards’ jobs in jeopardy.
Stephanie spends a week with the Coast Guard to help them crack a dangerous arms smuggling ring.
Matt doesn't know whose story to believe when he tries to reunite a runaway teen and her father.
A Hollywood producer desperate for a new TV series idea observes a Baywatch rescue.
After a minor earthquake, a geological survey team arrives at Baywatch, but trouble strikes again.
Stephanie and the geological team are trapped underwater by a massive earthquake!
After the earthquake which almost took his life, Hobie leaves California to live with his mother.
John Cort shows up at headquarters and convinces Mitch to compete in a dune buggy race.
Mitch has to work a 24-hour shift with Stephanie and Hobie is pressured into throwing a house party.
Hobie befriends a boy who has moved to California to live with his father after his mother's death.
Mitch helps a woman he calls “The Mermaid” who turns out to be the wife of a crime boss.

st: K-Gas The Grooveyard of Solid Gold
d: The Baywatch team is put on high alert when thousands of reckless treasure hunters storm the beach.
When the hot Santa Ana winds move in from the desert, things start heating up on the Baywatch beach.
A lifeguard-turned-hovercraft expert introduces new technology to the Baywatch team.
Matt and Hobie rescue a young boy who is being harassed by a thug and take care of him.
Joey joins Mitch and Hobie in decorating for Christmas. Father Ryan falls in love with CJ.
Logan's visa is soon to expire. Can he get his green card before he gets sent back to Australia?
Stephanie is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist. The Baywatch team must rescue her and save the day.
Mitch proposes to Tracy, but the happy moment is short-lived as she reveals she is terminal ill.

st: A Little Help From My Friends
d: Mitch is still mourning Tracy’s death, so Hobie seeks help from a radio show to help Mitch recover.
Mitch receives a mysterious package his father had put together before he died.
Andy, an old friend of Mitch, visits Baywatch to complete four days of lifeguard service.
Matt and CJ stumble upon a homeless man who shockingly turns out to be someone they know very well.
When testing out a new flying machine, Mitch spots a makeshift raft with a stranded woman in it.
Prominent British businessman Richard Branson visits Baywatch to perform several risky stunts.
Hobie’s idol comes to the beach, but Mitch is furious he turns out to have some questionable morals.
Mitch considers a new career working with Garner as a private eye. Logan cheats on Caroline again.
When a crippled oil rig sinks and floods with water, the team begins a desperate rescue effort.
Kaye asks Hobie to volunteer at a school for young blind children.
Cody and Neely rescue two surfers that fall ill due to a highly polluted beach.

st: To Everything There is a Season
d: Mitch's mother arrives in town and, after some strange occurrences, he insists she see a doctor.
Stephanie, CJ, and Caroline go on a girls-only junior lifeguard trip to Catalina.
Hobie's new friend Isaac’s risky behavior causes problems for the lifeguards.
Logan borrows Cody's car without permission and has an accident, then lies to the police.

st: Home is Where the Heat is
d: Matt returns to Baywatch and ends up trapped on a yacht with Neely and a group of ruthless pirates.
Logan and Caroline’s relationship hits a new low when Caroline returns his engagement ring.
Caroline blames herself for a teen's death in a fiery nighttime boating accident and gets PTSD.
A mysterious creature begins attacking beachgoers, and it is up to the Baywatch team to find it.
Logan must help his friend raise $50,000 to keep her ranch, and Jessie Lee Harris is back to help.
Stephanie, Caroline and CJ become Charlie’s Angels in a fun fantasy romp through 70's television.
CJ rescues pro wrestler Hulk Hogan, who is in town with Randy Savage to help save a Youth Center.
Mitch is convinced by Stephanie's boyfriend Tom to go sky-surfing but things go horribly wrong.
Stephanie is recruiting lifeguards for the annual Sailing Regatta against South Bay.
Mitch and Caroline rescue a woman who gets amnesia while trying to find her father.
The team is invited to Hawaii for a week to oversee new lifeguard techniques and relax a bit.
After Matt is stung by a poisonous fish they find a village where a young woman offers to help.
Kaye is reunited with old flame Wes Masters. Stephanie undergoes surgery for melanoma.
While in search of underwater treasure, Stephanie and Cody are confronted by drug smugglers.
Logan decides to write and direct a low-budget action film at the beach using a real shark.
When Mitch Judges the Miss Malibu Beach Bikini Contest his willpower is tested.
Max, a secretly rich homeless eccentric man, suddenly dies and leaves CJ his fortune.
At the annual Baywatch Bachelor Auction, Mitch is "bought" for $5,000 by a wealthy socialite.
LA is in the throes of a severe heat wave! Hundreds of thousands of people head to the beach.
Mitch hires MTV DJ Jenny McCarthy to throw "Beachblast" to raise money for the Special Olympics.
CJ's mother, a former Las Vegas showgirl, arrives in town to get away from her mobster ex-boyfriend.
Australia's Uncle Toby's International Ironman Competition sparks a battle of the sexes.
Controversy generated by Donna's appearance in Playboy magazine divides the Baywatch lifeguards.
Fire chief Captain Huntingdon and the Baywatch team form an elite joint Search and Rescue unit.
The team works with Heal the Bay after a recent rainstorm washes inland pollutants onto the beach.
Mitch has been chosen Flash Magazine's Bachelor of the Month, which causes some complications.
Stephanie and Tom go on their honeymoon in a two-mast schooner with a group of troubled teenagers.
Mitch gets his “15 minutes of fame” when he rescues Jay Leno from choking.
Caroline, Neely and Manny rescue three orphan teenage boys from drowning.
Manny is haunted by his past when two juvenile delinquents from his hometown arrive at Baywatch.
When a young couple’s romance is threatened by their parents, they make a pact to end their lives.
While testing new scuba diving technology, Sam, Neely and Caroline witness a jet crash.
CJ and Cody transport an injured sea lion to the animal recovery facility at Sea World.
Caroline finds herself being sued for negligence in civil court by the mother of a drowning victim.
A crazed young woman is causing trouble on the Venice Boardwalk and Neely suspects something is up.
A mysterious, disfigured man who the public dubs "the phantom lifeguard," is secretly saving people.
Lifeguard candidates compete for a chance to attend Rookie School and become Baywatch Lifeguards.
When a jet skier comes after April, Hobie finally shows that he's got Lifeguarding in his blood.
Veteran lifeguard Jack 'JD' Darius and Taylor Walsh both vie for the open Lieutenant slot.
Mitch, Sky and April find a dead man at the bottom of the ocean and search for answers.
April has trouble dealing with her brother’s cancer, but Mitch helps her see how special he is.
The lifeguards are plagued by a reporter who knows too much and gets in the way.
Seismic activity causes problems for the lifeguards.
When two sea lions are killed in an unexplainable event, Mitch must find the cause and stop it.
Stephanie is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist. The Baywatch team must rescue her and save the day.
When Cody breaks regulations, the Baywatch team makes a desperate attempt to locate a lost swimmer.
Caroline is hijacked by a young thief who forces her to drive him in a wild getaway chase.
A shark encounter leads Craig and April to take shelter in an intake pipe, avoiding deadly turbines.
Mitch and Cody are taken captive after discovering a stolen cache of US Marine weapons.
As jet skiers threaten the safety of the surfers in the water, personal turmoil rages on the beach.
Cody, JD, and Lani try to make some extra cash collecting Sea Urchins to sell in the Far East.
Garner Ellerbee returns and enlists Mitch’s help to track down a ring of offshore drug smugglers.
Cody makes a bet with some hotshots and Mitch ends up in a wild race with a finish no one expected.
After a swimmer shows symptoms of a deadly virus, headquarters is quarantined.
Neely's new nanny develops a deadly obsession with Mitch after he saves her from a boating disaster.
Hobie's good fortune lands him, Mitch, Cody and a jewel thief aboard a cruise ship to Alaska.

st: White Thunder at Glacier Bay, Part 1
d: During a stop in Juneau, Leslie takes a clueless Hobie on the beginning a harrowing chase.

st: White Thunder at Glacier Bay, Part 2
d: After rescuing a glacier-bound Hobie, Mitch returns with a romantic proposition for Neely.
Cody and April's plane crashes during a storm. Meanwhile Mitch's new life with Neely falls apart.
Mitch deals with Neely's confession as Cody and April race to save the survivors of the plane crash.
The conniving CEO of a private lifeguard company wants to take over Baywatch to expand her company.
Cody and Alex take her nephew to swim with dolphins in Hawaii, where Cody meets with Lani's sister.
A mysterious lifeguard begins making rescues around Baywatch but vanishes before being caught.
Jessie runs into an old beau who could destroy her future at Baywatch.
Hobie struggles with his role in a boating accident that left a girl in a coma.
Mitch befriends a young boy who joins the junior lifeguards in hopes of escaping a brutal home life.
Mitch, despondent from his failed marriage to Neely, goes for a day-long tower swim along the beach.
Mitch and Alex protect an orangutan, while Cody and Jessie deal with its abusive owner.
Cody puts his career, and life, on the line when he starts using a performance-enhancing supplement.
Mitch reunites an Army parachutist with her father, while Cody helps a free-diver reach a new "low.”.
Mitch ends up on the wrong side of the law after he tries to save Tanner from his abusive father.
Craig tells Mitch a shocking secret. Jessie tries to end JD and Cody's rivalry during a triathlon.
Mitch feels the need for speed when Tanner's cousin, Damon, a race car driver, visits Baywatch.
Mitch's lifeguard buddy's ex-wife dies in Australia so the team joins him on a trip down under.
While team Baywatch prepares to compete against the Australian lifeguards.
Cody learns a lesson in love when he and Mitch help a violinist escape her dangerous mentor.
Alex tries to save a diamond smuggler whose partners want him to "sleep with the fishes.".
After Manny suffers a life-altering injury during a rescue, April tries to save him from himself.
